streamTotals.get.description: Gets one of your stream totals (a count, an amount, the latest entry and the top donation), for a !subs or !tips command.

fields.type: What kind of event: follower, subscriber, tip, cheer, raid, superchat, kicks and so on.
fields.period: This stream, this week, this month or all time.

variables.totalPeriod: The period you picked (session, week, month or total)
variables.totalAmount: The amount added up (for follows and subs, the same as the count)
variables.totalGoal: The type's goal (0 when there is none)
variables.topDonationName: Who gave the biggest single amount in that period
variables.topDonatorName: Who gave the most in all in that period
variables.topDonatorAmount: How much they gave in all

streamTotals.reset.description: Starts this stream's totals again from zero. Week, month and all-time totals are kept.

streamTotals.setGoal.description: Sets the goal a goal bar shows for one type, like 100 followers.

fields.type: What kind of event: follower, subscriber, tip, cheer and so on.

streamTotals.set.description: Changes a total by hand, for example to fix a count after a test or to carry over a total from another bot.

fields.type: What kind of event: follower, subscriber, tip, cheer and so on.
fields.period: This stream, this week, this month or all time.
fields.count: The new count. Leave it empty to keep it.
fields.amount: The new amount. Leave it empty to keep it. For follows and subs the amount follows the count.

streamTotals.setLatest.description: Changes or clears the latest entry of one type (what a 'latest tip' label shows).

fields.type: What kind of event: follower, subscriber, tip, cheer and so on.
fields.name: The name to show. Leave it empty to clear the latest entry.

streamTotals.setTopDonation.description: Changes or clears the top donation (the biggest single amount) of one type for a period.

fields.type: tip, cheer, superchat, kicks, jewels, merch and so on.
fields.period: This stream, this week, this month or all time.
fields.name: Who gave it. Leave it empty to clear the top donation.

streamTotals.removeEvents.description: Takes stored events out of the totals and recalculates everything they counted in. By default it removes test and emulated events, for example after setting up overlays.

fields.testOnly: Ticked: only test and emulated events.
fields.type: Only this type. Leave it empty for every type.
fields.platform: Only events from this platform or service. Leave it empty for all.
fields.from: Only events from this date and time on, like 2026-11-17 18:00. Leave it empty for the oldest.
fields.to: Only events up to this date and time. Leave it empty for now.

streamTotals.resetMode.description: Chooses when this stream's totals start again: 15 minutes after your last platform goes offline, or only by hand.

fields.mode: 15 minutes after going offline, or Only by hand.
